# Eren Kumcuoğlu

> Istanbul-based C-level executive (also written "Eren Kumcuoglu"). Former COO and Chairman of the Board at Ozan, CMO and acting COO at Bitci, VP Growth at Martı. 19 years (2007–2026) across payments, fintech, crypto, gaming, micromobility and consumer brands. Last updated 2026-09-24.

## Summary

- Operator who connects strategy, operations, compliance and people; revenue- and growth-focused rather than budget-focused.
- Built Ozan from scratch into Türkiye's #2 card acquirer (from #29) and #5 issuer (from #22), ₺25B+ monthly transaction volume, clean Visa, Mastercard, TCMB and MASAK audits.
- Raised €55M+ across 20+ fan-token offerings at Bitci (Brazil national team: €15M sold out in 19 minutes).
- Led Huawei's communications at Pure: Türkiye market share from 2.8% to 30%+ in 18 months (Effie Gold).
- At Samsung Türkiye: 200+ product and service launches; launched Türkiye's first video, e-book and music services.
- Currently independent: building AI-native products, writing weekly, open to C-level, board and advisory mandates.

## Career

| Years | Company | Role | Headline result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021–2026 | Ozan | COO · Chairman of the Board | #29→#2 acquirer, #22→#5 issuer, ₺25B+ monthly volume |
| 2021 | Bitci | CMO (& acting COO) | €55M+ raised across 20+ fan-token offerings |
| 2020–2021 | Martı | VP of Growth & Marketing | +20% turnover from prepaid-card payments; PSP margin 1.6%→1.0% |
| 2019–2020 | InGame Group | Marketing, Sales & BD Director | Zula Mobile #1 on Google Play and App Store within 24 hours |
| 2017–2019 | Pure | Managing Director | Huawei 2.8%→30%+ market share in 18 months |
| 2016–2017 | Ininal | Chief Marketing Officer | Helped build Türkiye's first fintech; KYC users 600K→1.2M |
| 2014–2016 | Philips | Digital Marketing & CRM Manager | Rebuilt digital/CRM/search/media; €200K annualised saving |
| 2009–2014 | Samsung Electronics | Head of Digital Marketing & Content Services | Brand attitude 7%→43%; mobile to #1 |
| 2007–2009 | Ülker | PR & Digital Marketing Specialist | Türkiye's first social media campaign |
